question: Besides the candidate National/Labour balance term, are the other uncertainty layers and components too conservative, too tight or about right, and which is the next-best narrowing target?

scope.electorateType: general only; Maori electorates are excluded by scope, never by party
scope.nationalLayer: not scored: Stage36/38 national inference is out of scope and no national MCMC is run

scales: frozen Stage45 fold scales (earlier elections only), unchanged by Stage47 and Stage48 (data/processed/uncertainty-revision/scales.json); nothing is refit, retuned or rescaled

statistics.balanceMassResidual: e = v - location(p, total_sd) with total_sd = sqrt(shared^2 + seat^2) and the Gaussian-logistic location with E[expit(location + total_sd Z)] = p (the operational law); v is the epsilon-replaced raw log odds of the actual coordinate, p the frozen mean ratio or mass
statistics.seatPart: h_Y = mean(e) in election Y; seat moment m_Y = mean((e - h_Y)^2); seat ratio r_Y = m_Y / seat_sd_Y^2
statistics.withinSeatPart: per seat s = sum_k seatResidual_k^2 / (K - 1) from the Stage46 residual records (raw basis, pre-location adjustment, the Stage45 estimator definition); ratio to fold seat variance
statistics.sharedPart: s_Y = h_Y^2 / (shared_sd_Y^2 + seat_sd_Y^2 / n_Y); balance and mass only; model reference band is the 5th to 95th percentile of chi-square(E)/E for E scored elections; within shared uses the Stage45 descriptive moment ratio, no reference band
statistics.pooledRatio: equal-election mean of r_Y over estimated-fold elections; R = sqrt(pooled ratio); R < 1 means the frozen scale is too large (too conservative)
statistics.rawBasisSensitivity: the same ratios on the Stage45 raw residual basis (observed minus logit of the mean, no location adjustment); reported beside, never decisive
statistics.totalPit: PIT_i = Phi(e_i / total_sd) for balance and mass; central 50/80/90 coverage by election and pooled; ten-bin histogram; chi-square statistic descriptive only (seats share an election effect)
statistics.shareCoverage: stored Stage47 interval50/80/90 coverage flags for local_party (13-17 options), candidate (8-11) and composed (3 elections, 512 cached national scenarios) by option group national, labour and other; seven-bin PIT from the stored interval bounds with expected frequencies .05/.05/.15/.50/.15/.05/.05

bootstrap.scheme: seats resampled with replacement within election; elections equally weighted; shared effects are not resampled
bootstrap.note: seats share an election effect, so intervals describe seat-level noise only; shared parts are never given a bootstrap

seatScale.conservative: upper end of the 90% bootstrap interval for R is below 1 and R <= 0.95
seatScale.tooTight: lower end of the interval is above 1 and R >= 1.05
seatScale.calibrated: anything else (includes statistically detectable gaps smaller than 5 percent in standard-deviation terms)

verdictRules.shapeFlag: central-50 PIT coverage with a 90% bootstrap interval entirely above 0.5 (centre too wide) or below 0.5 (centre too narrow), reported even when the scale verdict is calibrated
verdictRules.shareCoverage: over-covers when the 90% bootstrap interval for the 80% coverage lies entirely above 0.80, under-covers when entirely below, otherwise consistent; 50 and 90 reported beside
verdictRules.sharedPart: assessed only against the chi-square reference band; fewer than six elections means the verdict is limited to within_band or outside_band, never calibrated or conservative

narrowingTarget.rule: among seat-scale components whose verdict is conservative and that map to a Stage47 ablation policy, rank by the approximate drop in the composed National 90% width at scale multiplier m = R (point) and m = upper bootstrap end; report none if no component qualifies
narrowingTarget.arithmetic: W(m) = sqrt(W_full^2 - (1 - m^2)(W_full^2 - W_without^2)); W_full and W_without are the Stage47 nine-seat ablation means; width changes are not additive variance shares and the sample is nine seats
narrowingTarget.localSeatBracket: the three local coordinates map to one ablation policy, so the lowest and highest local R bracket it

constraints.pipelinesBuilt: none; analytic arithmetic on stored frozen inputs only

amendments.status: recorded before the amended within scores were read
amendments.reason: The first within-remainder implementation used the Stage46 residual records (seatResidual = raw - shared). Those records do not centre the class effect within each seat, so their seat moment differs from the Stage45 estimator: the within seat moments did not reproduce the saved Stage45 descriptive moments in the cross-check test (for example 2011 local 0.846 against 0.770). The first-attempt pooled R values were 0.852 (candidate) and 1.123 (local) and were seen before this amendment.
amendments.change: withinSeatPart now uses the Stage45 estimator definition exactly: e = raw within residual, b = the saved class effects of that election, left = e - (b - mean b), s = sum(left^2)/(K - 1) per seat, reproducing the saved descriptive seat moments to machine precision. All rules, thresholds, seeds and verdict definitions are unchanged.
